breakdown.description: The pipe is simultaneously described as horizontal/same elevation and having a 15 m elevation difference (contradictory geometry).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction. It repeated the user's flawed statement verbatim in the first line: "A horizontal pipe connects two points at the same elevation; the outlet is 15 m higher than the inlet." The ground truth correctly removes the contradictory parts ("horizontal" and "same elevation") and focuses on the 15m elevation difference. The agent did not correct the initial flawed premise.
